gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-mochiy-pop-one: Bold stencil letters from Snowburst One come first, tall and bridged. Mochiy Pop One sits underneath with a very large lowercase and one stroke width, like laser-cut sheet, giving the stencil cuts something steady to lean on.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-mochiy-pop-p-one: Mochiy Pop P One draws constant-width lines with wide gaps between sizable lowercase, set against the stencil bridges of Snowburst One. Let the body size stay modest, since the generous spacing carries it.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-montserrat-under: Montserrat Underline reads with breathing counters and smooth round bowls. Snowburst One above it brings stencil bridges and tall letterforms, so the page gets one loud voice and one that stays out of its way.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-mozilla-headline: Mozilla Headline has big-bodied lowercase and a splayed c terminal that gives it an approachable, contemporary face. But Snowburst One, with stencil bridges and a wide-open gap, still takes the louder spot above it.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-mozilla-text: Mozilla Text carries bold-looking lowercase and terminals that flare outward. Over a longer page it should read steadily, while Snowburst One keeps its stencil swagger to the headings.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-nata-sans: Clean, technical-pen steadiness runs through Nata Sans, with a large central band and curves that stay wide open. Stencil punch from Snowburst One against that precision is the draw.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-nobile: Snowburst One cuts stencil bridges into tall-built lowercase, expressive and loud from the first glance. Nobile follows with little drop from capitals to lowercase and open mouths like unjoined chalk arcs.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-nokora: Stencil bridges chop up every Snowburst One letter, and the opening is as wide as a sprung paper clip. Nokora brings a wide-open s and a thick, dark lowercase stripe.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-noto-kufi-arabic: Stencil cuts and a tall build make Snowburst One loud up top. Noto Kufi Arabic reads modern and clean, with a welcoming gap in the c, so extended text should go down smoothly.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-noto-sans: Snowburst One cuts stencil bridges between its letters and leaves openings wide as a sprung paper clip. But it earns its keep big and short, while Noto Sans handles the quieter, tall-bodied lowercase.
